text:
Dear colleagues,

I want to thank everyone on the Companion Animal Travel Desk for the calm, steady work you have been doing this week. Our travelers and their companions rely on us to keep each handoff smooth, and your attention to detail makes a real difference. Please keep using the current care notes carefully, and continue checking carrier labels, route details, and comfort needs before each transfer. Small steps like confirming water access, ventilation, and secure handling help prevent stress for both pets and owners.

For the current Vellmar service flow, please keep the lounge and relief-area information close at hand while speaking with ground staff and flight teams. <<FACT F002>> When you are working with families traveling with nervous pets, remember that a calm voice and a clear handoff plan often ease the entire process. <<FACT F014>> If a case changes during the day, update the shared record right away so the next person has a complete picture and there is no confusion at pickup.

Thank you again for staying alert, flexible, and kind. The care we give from booking through arrival reflects well on Aurelia Skyways, and I appreciate how consistently you support one another. Please continue to bring questions or concerns to me early so we can solve them before they affect a traveler or pet. Companion Animal Travel Desk,
